title: Show the language and locale settings
summary: Check which language, text encoding, and number and date formats your system uses. This only reads the settings and changes nothing.

aliases.text: what encoding does my system use
формат дат и чисел в системе

steps.explain: Show the current locale settings. The LANG line is the default language and encoding; each LC_ line sets one category, such as LC_NUMERIC for numbers, LC_TIME for dates and LC_CTYPE for text encoding.
steps.expect: Lines such as LANG=en_US.UTF-8: the part before the dot is language and region, the part after it is the encoding. On a minimal system LANG may be empty and categories show "POSIX".

steps.explain: List the locales installed on this system. Only locales from this list can be used, so your current one should appear here.
steps.expect: A list of names such as C, C.utf8 and POSIX on a minimal system. A desktop system usually lists more, such as en_US.utf8 or ru_RU.utf8.
